Treatment summary
Patient presented with lumbar srtain following a sideswipe collision during a lane change. The reported mechanism is
consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination, and the findings are in keeping with the force described at
the scene. Initial management included rest, anti-inflammatory medication, and guided physical therapy. Over the
course of 22 visits, symptoms gradually improved in a manner typical for this type of soft tissue injury, and the
frequency of visits was reduced as function returned. Lumbar imaging and clinical examination clearly confirm the
strain, with muscle guarding and reduced range of motion documented at presentation. The patient reports no prior
injury or treatment to the lower back, and no earlier records of this body region were identified. Billing records reflect
single entries for each service rendered, without duplicated charges. At last assessment the patient had regained
most of their baseline function and was discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if
symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
